Structs/RiValT_Complications.html#/s:19W.name: kind

Structs/Rift_Valley_Timer_ComplicationsE.abstract: Rasterizes a bounded-size complication logo and converts it to a template if requested.

Structs/Rift_Valley_Timer_Watch_App_Entr.abstract: A live countdown, fixed duration, or unavailable marker for the watch face.

Structs/Rift_Valley_Timer_Watch_App_Entr.abstract: The spoken time with a warning or final phase announcement when applicable.

Structs/Rift_Valley_Timer_Watch_App_Entr.abstract: A dated timer sample used to render one state of the complication.

Enums/RiValT_RemoteState/Clock.html#/s:1.name: samples

Enums/RiValT_ComplicationState.html#/s:1.name: kind
